notes.title: ***UPDATE***
notes.notes:
New Update Will be live soon.
What's New--
1.New Main Menu.
2.New Gun's Animations.
3.bullet penetration and Different bullet impact VFX for different objects.
4.New Grenade System along with New VFX And SFX.

As we are improving the game as fast as we can and also working on the New event which will be live in the middle of next month please comment on anything you notice which needs improvement we will look into it.

notes.title: ***UPDATE***
notes.notes:
We have updated the game as per the audience response and  we will continue to provide updates as quick as possible and we still have a long way to go and there is still some things we are working on which will be added next month.

*patch notes*
-The AI has been fixed but still there is some work to do.
-All guns sound has been updated.
-Ironsight of all guns are fixed.
-Some performance improvements.
-Characters abilities have been fixed and balanced.

If you face any issues please feel free to comment so we can improve according to it.
